# Vendored libraries

Served from this folder so the app runs without a CDN (venue Wi-Fi is unreliable).

| File | Source | Version | License |
|------|--------|---------|---------|
| `opencv.js` | npm `@techstark/opencv-js` (`dist/opencv.js`), an OpenCV.js build | 4.10.0-release.1 | Apache-2.0 |

`docs.opencv.org/4.10.0/opencv.js` returns 404, which is why the npm build is used.
